prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but to recommend specific lawyers I need a bit more about your case. First, immediate steps and deadlines you should know:

Immediate steps (if you haven’t already)
- Get medical care and follow doctors’ orders (important for health and your claim).
- Preserve evidence: photos of vehicles, injuries, scene; witness contact info; police report number.
- Keep records of medical bills, lost wages, repair estimates, text messages, and insurance communications.
- Don’t sign releases or accept a settlement offer without talking to an attorney.

Important deadlines
- California personal injury statute of limitations: generally 2 years from the accident date (Code of Civil Procedure §335.1).
- Property-damage claims: generally 3 years.
- If a government vehicle or public property was involved, you may have only 6 months to file a claim — act quickly.

Before I recommend specific lawyers, tell me:
- When did the accident happen?
- What injuries did you sustain (briefly)?
- Was the other driver clearly at fault? Was there a police report?
- Have you already spoken to an insurance company or received a settlement offer?
- Do you prefer a small local firm or a larger regional firm? Any language or accessibility needs?

How to choose the right lawyer (quick checklist)
- Experience: look for attorneys who focus on car-accident/personal-injury cases and have handled cases like yours.
- Trial experience: many cases settle, but hire someone comfortable going to trial if needed.
- Track record: ask about settlements/verdicts in similar cases (results vary by facts).
- Fee structure: most personal-injury lawyers work on contingency (no fee unless you recover). Confirm percentage and any costs you may owe if you lose.
- Communication: how quickly will they respond and who handles your calls (attorney vs. paralegal)?
- Resources: firm should be able to advance costs for experts, medical-record retrieval, accident reconstruction if needed.
- Local knowledge: Pleasanton/Alameda County experience helps with local judges, insurers, and medical providers.
- Reputation: check CA State Bar for standing/discipline and look at client reviews (Google, Avvo, Yelp) — but weigh reviews carefully.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How long have you handled auto injury cases?
- Have you handled cases with injuries like mine? What was the outcome?
- Do you handle cases on contingency? What percentage and what costs will I be responsible for?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?
- Do you try cases or mostly settle?
- How long do you expect this will take?
- Can you provide references from past clients?

How I can help next
- If you want, I can search for and give you a short list (3–5) of personal-injury attorneys or firms near Pleasanton with good reputations and relevant experience. Tell me your preferences and the details above, and I’ll put together options and sample questions to ask at consultations.

Would you like me to find a shortlist of attorneys now? If so, share the accident date and a few details (injury severity, whether a government entity was involved, any offers from insurers).
